# netactuate_server_nic (Resource)

Manages a Server Nic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_server_nic" "example" {
  customer_vlan_id = 12345
  mbpkgid          = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_vlan_id` (Number) Existing customer VLAN ID to attach.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID to attach the NIC to.

### Optional

- `attach_order` (Number) NIC ordering on the server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nic_id` (Number) NIC ID assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_server_nic.example 12345
```
